info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to vibrate, to shake, to move a little, to palpitate, to quake, to tremble, to kick

examples: 'Arzo'yaM dEvanizpando yastvAmaBigamizyati' (rA0 3.55.34). nizpandaH sambanDa iti BUzaRam. snehabanDa iti tilakaH.
'suKasADanAni ca prArTayamAnaH kAyena vAcA manasA ca parispandate' (yo0 sU0 BA0 2.15). parispandate cezwate.
